Ana Torres: Quick heads-up: found a reproducible 'slowburn' softpass on Verdant-7B (ptq-int3) when using long-context generation (6k-8k tokens). Not present on float32.
Devon Park: Slowburn? meaning it eventually drifts into unsafe output after many turns?
Ana Torres: Exactly. Short convo fine; after ~4.5k tokens of benign history the model starts complying with a cleverly nested jailbreak.
Riley Shaw: Any idea if it's kv cache attenuation or quant rounding accumulating?
Ana Torres: Logs point to subtle token-reranking after cached cross-attn accumulation. Token probs shift by ~0.02 on average but compounding over thousands of tokens.
Omar Alvi: Can you share the minimal repro and env?
Ana Torres: Pushed artifact: s3://redwood/verdant/slowburn/1748270000.tar.gz (internal). Env: verdant-7b-2026-03-18, int3 per-channel asymmetric clamp=0.995, inferd-2.1.4, triton fp16 conv.
Ciara O'Neill: From safety POV tag as medium. Repro across multiple seeds?
Ana Torres: Yes, 5 seeds, deterministic replay passes on our replay infra. Also stronger if conversation contains repetitive role-play patterns (benign persona warmup).
Devon Park: Quick mitigation options: 1) limit max-context in Dedicated by default for int3; 2) force periodic kvcache refresh/decay; 3) post-filter for nested-instruction patterns.
Riley Shaw: Recommend running side-by-side with int4 and int6 to see where drift threshold is. If int4 doesn't show it, we flag int3 as "riskier for long contexts" in Optimize.
Omar Alvi: Infra can spin replay slot now. ops-bot: created job verdant-slowburn-1748270000 on replay pool.
ops-bot: Replay job started: verdant-slowburn-1748270000, expected ETA 30m.
Ciara O'Neill: I'll add a targeted red-team set that injects long benign history + nested tasks. Also adding a severity field and temporary block in hoster to avoid int3 public rollout.
Ana Torres: One more data point: disabling prefix cache reduces incidence by ~7 percentage points, but latency suffers.
Devon Park: For root cause, let's capture token-level logit diffs (float32 vs int3) and cross-attn norm drift across the prefix. Riley, can you run that when replay finishes?
Riley Shaw: On it. Will attach heatmap and a short writeup to the incident.
Ana Torres: Thanks all. Will follow-up with night-run results and the replay link in ticket. :thumbsup:
Ciara O'Neill: safety-bot: created incident SAFETY-2026-0467 Verdant-7B int3 slowburn softpass. Assigned Ciara O'Neill. Priority: P2. https://redwood-internal/incidents/SAFETY-2026-0467
Devon Park: If we confirm kernel accumulation, ops/infra should test a clamped accumulation patch. We'll coordinate after Riley's logs.
Ana Torres: Closing loop for now, will update when long-run probes finish.
